summary.headline: Astrampsychos Oracles and Lunar Lots
summary.text: Catalog of a Neapolitan codex’s lots, lunar dream interpretation, the life of St. Nicholas, grammatical material, Astrampsychos’s inquiries and oracles, prophetic decades, and Petosiris’s lunar-number work. It cites related Milanese, Modenese, and Florentine codices and R. Hercher’s edition, ending with a four-column table of Moon days and numbers.
